world:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: environment key art for The Last Throne, a stylized Roblox cooperative fantasy action RPG.
Create a polished wide landscape concept illustration, approximately 16:9, of GLOAMWOOD, an ominous forest whose paths and ancient watchfort have become a giant spider hunting ground. Dense ancient blue-black and deep green trees form a closed canopy. Thick silver-white silk connects tree trunks high above the ground; a broken wooden supply cart hangs in silk between branches, not on the ground. A few fully wrapped, non-graphic rescue cocoons hang near a ruined woodland watchfort, no visible injury or exposed bodies. The clear winding traversable path remains readable in pale moonlight, with low fog confined near roots. A small warm amber survivor shelter occupies a safe clearing to the left, with two tiny blocky traveler silhouettes for scale; no combat companion party. In the distance, roots pierce the stone watchfort, and a partial silhouette of an enormous purple armored spider is barely visible inside its huge arched entrance. The forest is the main subject, not a dungeon interior.
Style: premium stylized 3D fantasy game concept, chunky sculpted tree forms and angular stonework, clean faceted materials and crisp readable silhouettes, dramatic but not photoreal horror. Spider identity: glossy black-purple segmented exoskeleton, long angular legs, subtle violet glow, no humanoid torso.
Palette: midnight blue/deep forest green, silver silk, limited violet enemy accents, warm amber safety area. Moonlight and reflected ground light must reveal the actual walkable floor. Strong foreground/midground/background depth and compelling sense of exploration.
Only text: small elegant title "GLOAMWOOD" and subtitle "THE SILKEN DARK", both exact English and unobtrusive. No epic number, UI, stats, map markers, watermarks, portals, giant magic crystals, gore, dismemberment, modern equipment, zombie graveyard, or nearly black unreadable areas. This is a new forest candidate, not a visual remake of old epics 5-8.
